camera.in_phone: none. Withdrawn by the client on 18/08 — .screen-world holds scale 1, x 0, y 0 for the whole scene and is never tweened. The device itself is never scaled or translated either.
camera.replacement: the stretch the push used to own (now 5.5-9.0s) is filled by staged arrivals: the button's icon swap, the working state, the stage copy's second line, the glow lift, and the once-per-second resend tick.

retime.method: hold time first, motion time last. Every entrance, press, icon-swap and copy tween keeps its original duration and ease; the 2s came out of the typing GAP (0.8s -> 0.62s between digits) and out of the two dead beats — the wait before the first digit (1.7s -> 1.55s focus, 2.6s -> 2.15s first digit) and the wait between the sixth digit and the commit (1.05s -> 0.86s). The spinner was re-rated (1000deg/2.78s -> 840deg/2.33s) so it still turns at ~1 rev/s rather than speeding up with the cut.

exit.vector: the request is in flight: the button's Loader2 turns at ~1 rev/s (840 deg over 6.67-9.0s, linear) — ~82 canvas px/s tangential at the 26px glyph — while the resend counter ticks one digit per second and the rail keeps filling. Nothing translates; the phone is locked at its rest position.
exit.last_second: 8.0-9.0s: the glow lift finishes at 8.7, the spinner keeps turning, the resend counter ticks 50 -> 49 and the rail keeps filling. No element is parked and nothing new is introduced — the frame hands the next cut a surface already in motion.

entry.vector: lateral wizard advance: the step card slides +x (screen-right, RTL-forward) from -46px on power3.out over 0.55s => ~237 canvas px/s at t=0. This is the shared seam grammar of the whole signup run (03 -> 07). No camera motion of any kind at t=0.
entry.first_second: 0.0-1.0s: the card slides in, the 5-step rail flips חשבון -> .done and אימות -> current (0.15-0.60), the stage title and first body line land (0.15 / 0.35), and the five card rows begin their 0.09s-staggered arrival at 0.55. Unchanged by the retime.

carrier.steps: 5-step .steps row, index 1 (אימות). At t=0 it renders in the INCOMING state from frame 03 (all muted); at 0.15-0.60s חשבון flips to .done (accent) and אימות to current (filled teal). It then holds unchanged through the final second, so frame 05 can pick it up mid-state at its own t=0.
carrier.device: the phone is never rebuilt: same .device (460x997, natural scale), same slot, no entrance tween. Only the screen contents advance.
carrier.screen: AuthLayout, not MainShell — the register wizard is a guest route, so there is no app header and no bottom nav. Chrome is the back row (חזרה) plus the step rail.
carrier.rail: bottom progress rail scaleX 0.8095 -> 1.0 linear across the whole 9s (14.92% -> 18.41% of the film). The absolute endpoints are unchanged by the retime — only the time taken to cross them — so frames 03 and 05 still hand off at the same fill.
carrier.clock: the resend cooldown ticks one digit per second for the whole scene: 58 -> 49 over 9s (was 58 -> 47 over 11s). The rate is the invariant, not the span.
